<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
  <!-- This root note does not describe a dictionary entry. -->
  <dict>
    <!-- Preserve the original entity spelling in this native key. -->
    <key>escaped&key</key>
    <!-- Structural comments between key and value remain untouched. -->
    <string>North & pier</string>

    <!-- Both the key and its source value use literal CDATA. -->
    <key><![CDATA[cdata<&>key]]></key>
    <string><![CDATA[<quiet> & calm]]></string>

    <!-- Mixed XML text and CDATA retain their original boundaries. -->
    <key>mixed.key</key><string>North <![CDATA[<quiet> & calm]]> pier</string>

    <!-- A self-closing value expands without rewriting its attributes. -->
    <key>empty.key</key><string custom="reserved" />

    <!-- Explicit empty elements use a zero-width source slot. -->
    <key>explicit.empty</key><string></string>

    <!-- Numeric references and positional Foundation formatters remain native. -->
    <key>newline.key</key><string>NorthSouth</string>
    <key>placeholder.key</key><string>Ready %1$@</string>
    <key>percent.newline</key><string>North%nSouth</string>
    <key>percent.literal</key><string>Ready 50%%</string>

    <!-- Supplementary characters precede later byte-owned values. -->
    <key>unicode.🧭</key><string>équipe</string>
  </dict>
</plist>
